analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 240,000) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 231,500/255,150/297,416) — above SMA5, below SMA20/50, indicating short-term weakness and mid-term bearishness.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 (KRW 258,645/194,170) — below SMA100, above SMA200, showing mixed mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (56.2%) + current price level is historically in the middle range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (35.7 → 44.4) — attempting to exit oversold, pre-neutral zone entry.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-4054.6654 → -181.6715) — improving within weak convergence, trend reversal signal still weak.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band KRW 255,150) — trading around the middle band, 36.63% band width indicates sustained volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (KRW 182,800) — based on Pivot S1 level.
· Swing Resistance (KRW 303,600) — based on Pivot R1 level, breaking through would strengthen upward momentum.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways) — no clear trend pattern formed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.65) — contracted compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) — waiting for directional confirmation.
